verdict.rationale: Jules is a cloud coding agent, so attaching a screenshot or mockup to guide a visual change is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions image, screenshot or mockup attachments. Task input is described only as text: GitHub issue labels, submitted tasks, API messages and AGENTS.md.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change
